cases.name: Michelle Anne Meyer Trout
cases.narrative: Michelle was staying at the Best Western Hotel in Washington when he went to the location to conduct surveillance. She had been staying a hotels since their divorce filing. As Michelle was exiting her hotel room, Trout yelled at her.  When she turned around, Trout allegedly shot her in the face with a .357 Magnum revolver.  When she fell into her car, Trout allegedly shot her two more times.  She was pronounced dead at the scene.
